title: H2O America (HTO) Prices 11.48M Share Offering at $53 per Share
title_zh: H2O America (HTO) 以每股 53 美元的价格发行 1148 万股股票
summary: H2O America (NASDAQ:HTO) is included among the Dividend Kings List: Top 15 Stocks. On March 3, H2O America (NASDAQ:HTO) priced its previously announced public offering of 11.48 million common shares at $53 per share.
summary_zh: H2O America（纳斯达克股票代码：HTO）被列入股息之王名单：前 15 名股票。 3 月 3 日，H2O America（纳斯达克股票代码：HTO）将之前宣布的 1148 万股普通股公开发行定价为每股 53 美元。

title: KKR Leans Into Sports With Arctos Deal And Insider Share Buying
title_zh: KKR 通过 Arctos 交易和内部股票购买进军体育领域
summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) has agreed to acquire Arctos Partners, a specialist investor in professional sports franchises and related assets. The deal is intended to expand KKR's exposure to sports, real estate, and media rights through Arctos' existing platform.
summary_zh: KKR（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）已同意收购 Arctos Partners，这是一家专业体育特许经营权和相关资产的专业投资者。该交易旨在通过 Arctos 的现有平台扩大 KKR 在体育、房地产和媒体版权方面的业务。

title: How The GeoPark (NYSE:GPRK) Investment Story Is Shifting With New Targets And Takeover Tensions
title_zh: 地质公园（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GPRK）的投资故事如何随着新目标和收购紧张局势而变化
summary: GeoPark’s updated fair value estimate has moved slightly, with the price target adjusted from US$11.32 per share to US$11.40 per share.
summary_zh: GeoPark更新后的公允价值预估略有变动，目标价格从每股11.32美元调整至每股11.40美元。

title: Blackstone, Ares Back $5 Billion Financing for Thoma Bravo's WWEX-Auctane Merger
title_zh: Blackstone 和 Ares 为 Thoma Bravo 的 WWEX-Auctane 合并提供 50 亿美元融资
summary: Private credit lenders fund Thoma Bravo's logistics-software tie-up, valuing the combined WWEX and Auctane business at about $11.6 billion.
summary_zh: 私人信贷机构为 Thoma Bravo 的物流软件合作提供资金，对 WWEX 和 Auctane 业务的合并估值约为 116 亿美元。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
